stem:
Zara records lab times using seconds, minutes, and hours.

Which claims are correct? One or more options may be correct.

options.text: The SI unit of time is the second; 60 s = 1 min.
The SI unit of time is the minute.

teacher.key_rationale: SI time unit is the second, with 60 s = 1 min, so 180 s = 3 min. Calling the minute the SI unit or writing 1 h = 120 s are wrong conversions.
